# Dataspryva documentation

Published Actor references and Python usage recipes.

- [99acres City & BHK Property Listing Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/2TFMROZoJNU2eMqGS/): Search 99acres by city, BHK size, property type, locality, and price range to get structured buy and rent listings across 25 major Indian cities, with price, area, location, and poster details.
- [Amazon Deals Grid Tracker by Category & Discount](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/yZ5tcZFmAAXi1egIo/): Pull Amazon's Today's Deals grid across 23 marketplaces, with deal price, list price, savings amount/percent, deal type, brand, and department for each product. Filter by category, brand, price range, and discount range.
- [Amazon Review Aggregates & Extended History Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/OgPzorRclF6tasDvP/): Collect Amazon customer reviews and rating summaries by product URL, ASIN, or keyword across 19 marketplaces, with star-rating and sort filters, reviewer images, and an optional session for deeper review history.
- [Baidu Web, Image & News Results Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/psB9o5eBtflSKjKWE/): Runs search queries against Baidu's web, image, or news results and returns titles, URLs, snippets, dates, and image metadata, with filters for time range, file type, site, and exact phrase.
- [Bol.com Product Search, Price & Stock Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/5o3SucGekbCXdfc83/): Searches Bol.com by keyword, category, EAN, or promotions page and returns price, rating, stock status, and seller for each product, with no login required.
- [Brazilian CNPJ Bulk Lookup & Partner Records Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/cNSljbP1ozrKhKG5H/): Look up any number of Brazilian CNPJ numbers and get official Receita Federal data: company name, legal status, CNAE industry codes, address, founding date, capital, tax regime, and the partner (QSA) list for each one.
- [Crexi Commercial Property Listings & Pricing Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/dZkzHEvhJd9SJS0qj/): Collects active commercial real estate listings from Crexi across any US state and 14 property types, with asking price, square footage, location, and brokerage details.
- [Dailymotion Video Discovery by Topic & Channel](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/XGXbbohKOjk6aa6HB/): Search Dailymotion by keyword, browse trending or topic videos, or pull a channel's uploads, with language, country, and duration filters, views, likes, tags, and owner details per video.
- [DeviantArt Artwork Search, Gallery & Trending Feed](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/kRArTHZZpiZh36Qda/): Reads DeviantArt's public feeds to find deviations by keyword, browse an artist's full gallery, or pull the current trending artwork feed by category.
- [DexScreener Token Pair & Boosted Token Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/MOa8uJUJGEpUpfB7L/): Look up decentralized exchange trading pairs by token or pair address, search tokens by name or symbol, or pull the latest boosted tokens and token profiles across 20 blockchains. Returns price, liquidity, volume, and transaction counts.
- [Expedia Hotel Rate & Guest Rating Finder](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/aGnG4rQ2ykpjOw44W/): Searches Expedia for a destination and travel dates and returns hotel names, nightly and total pricing, guest ratings, neighborhoods, and promotional badges.
- [Florida Sunbiz Registry Lookup by Name, Agent & FEI](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/JTEsf3n3srGWrLiKV/): Look up Florida business entities on the Sunbiz registry by entity name, officer, registered agent, FEI/EIN, document number, ZIP, or street address, and get status, addresses, officers, annual filings, and filed-document links for each match.
- [G2 Software Reviews, Product Info & Competitor Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/AYL1CXwlY4oaFSyJ4/): Collects G2 software product reviews with ratings and pros/cons, product profile summaries, or competitor listings from any G2 product page.
- [Google Autocomplete Keyword Expansion Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/l720olFLJbUgIME9n/): Expand seed keywords into long-tail suggestions using Google's autocomplete, with question-word, preposition, comparison, and A-to-Z expansion modes across any country and language.
- [Google Maps Business Lead & Email Finder](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/nzmL4XdPKeDa1Ahe3/): Find business leads on Google Maps by category, keyword, or location and collect name, address, phone, website, rating, review count, and coordinates. Optionally adds emails and social links found on each business's own website.
- [Google Maps Grid-Based Market Saturation Scanner](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/lEvpsUsigS536O8Wg/): Cover a bounding box, circle, or custom polygon with a search grid to collect every business Google Maps exposes for a query, well beyond the usual 120-result cap on a single search.
- [Google Patents Inventor, Assignee & Citation Lookup](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/qGwyVKXBvzDrcnIAf/): Search Google's aggregated patent index by keyword, inventor, assignee, classification code, or citation graph, and get abstract, claims, dates, family, and citations for each matching patent.
- [Google Scholar Paper & Citation Search Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/XT8wyKa1C9SYFQYTh/): Search Google Scholar by keyword and get structured records for papers and citations, with author, venue, year, citation counts, and links to PDFs and related work. Filter by year range, document format, and article type.
- [Greenhouse ATS Job Board Lookup by Company](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/iAMfb4Uf2haeImsKk/): Pull every open role from one or more Greenhouse company boards, or look up specific postings by job ID, with location, department, employment type, salary, and apply link for each.
- [Handshake Campus Jobs & Employer Showcase Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/matudr5BfHfTMG3Ec/): Reads Handshake's public job explore page for campus internships and entry-level roles, plus the public employer showcase, returning title, company, location, salary, and deadline.
- [Hcareers Hotel & Restaurant Job Finder by Category](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/7RmIU4jIs8a7yOKmM/): Search Hcareers hospitality job listings by keyword, location, state/province, or 26 job categories, with employment-type and remote filters, full descriptions, and parent-brand details.
- [Hepsiburada Product Search & Category Price Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/uHUJG57Ky3nZjRKsG/): Search Hepsiburada by keyword, browse a category page, look up specific product URLs, or find a keyword's top sellers, and get price, rating, discount, and seller details for each product.
- [iQIYI Album Profile & Channel Ranking Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/LkWGg07CebatgVipI/): Get iQIYI drama, movie, anime and variety-show details by album ID, pull the top-ranked titles for any channel, or fetch search-box suggestions for a query. Returns genres, cast, episode counts, ratings and licensed regions.
- [LinkedIn Profile Engagement Timeline Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/ENtqoTbxwWPCmRg9X/): Pull a LinkedIn profile's posts, reposts, comments, and reactions in one run, with the original post's author, text, and link attached to each activity. Needs your own LinkedIn session cookie.
- [LinkedIn University Alumni Search by Degree & Year](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/cjWVUgzowY5Z65q1C/): Search a university's LinkedIn alumni by field of study, degree, graduation year, current employer, and location, and get each match's profile, current role, and detected education details. Needs your own LinkedIn session cookie.
- [Mercari Japan Listings by Condition, Price & Status](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/lGwJaWQQLr64msxVU/): Search Mercari Japan by keyword and filter by item condition, listing status, and price range in JPY, with seller, category, images, and listing URL for each match.
- [Multi-League Season Results & Team Lookup](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/cIiSpiIctD5BGgSun/): Get final scores for a season across 10 major soccer, football, basketball, baseball, and hockey leagues, or look up every team's roster details for a league in one run.
- [Naver Map Business Listings with Menu & Hours Data](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/l8lB2zLDoXJ2xjpAe/): Search Naver Map by keyword or place URL and get address, phone, weekly hours, menu with prices, amenities, transit access, booking links, and review scores for each business.
- [Noon.com Multi-Market Product Search by Discount](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/qDg5x3pgFoSyTs8EB/): Search Noon.com's UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt storefronts by keyword, category, or URL, and get price, discount, rating, brand, and promotional labels for each product in that market's own currency.
- [Official MLB Team, Schedule & Stat Line Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/rg2FBxNB1s8X13GRi/): Get baseball data from MLB's own public Stats API: season hitting, pitching, and fielding lines, team rosters, game schedules and scores, or live division standings. No authentication required.
- [OP.GG League of Legends Tier List & Win Rate Tracker](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/F1hKMOSMTFvpnchDf/): Reads OP.GG's League of Legends champion tier lists for any lane and returns tier, win rate, pick rate, ban rate, and patch version per champion.
- [Property Finder MENA Listings & Agent Contact Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/6tmA1k9u56N6klleB/): Reads Property Finder listings across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, and Egypt, returning price, size, location hierarchy, amenities, and agent or brokerage contact details.
- [Quora Question, Answer & Profile Search Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/4f1nWGGi2uy4RE0qo/): Search Quora by keyword or scrape question, answer, profile, topic, Space, and post URLs directly, and get the text, author details, and engagement counts of each visibly accessible page, with clear status rows for anything blocked.
- [Rent the Runway Designer Rental Catalog Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/mqAo1eFbT4I0XniBx/): Browses or searches Rent the Runway's designer rental catalog by category, designer, occasion, color, and price, returning rental price, retail price, sizes in stock, and ratings.
- [SimplyHired Job Search & Salary Parser](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/tKgUBufy4olHGAYVB/): Search SimplyHired by keyword, location, employment type, remote work, and salary, and get parsed salary ranges, benefits, qualifications, and full descriptions for each job.
- [Snapchat Topic Spotlight Feed & Content Tag Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/1pDXF7JRNIfGATKcB/): Reads a Snapchat topic's public Spotlight feed and returns each video with creator, engagement counts, AI-generated title/keywords, and related content-classification tags.
- [StockTwits Ticker Sentiment & Trending Symbol Feed](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/gO7zdvF0aSw7rDweu/): Reads StockTwits' public message stream for any ticker or user, the market-wide trending-symbols list with trend summaries, and ticker search, including each post's self-tagged sentiment.
- [TikTok Hashtag Momentum & Top Creator Tracker](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/yVYeUmb7hb4vybt1d/): Reads TikTok Creative Center's trending-hashtag list for any country and returns rank, post and view counts, a day-by-day momentum curve, and top creators behind each trend.
- [TikTok Keyword & Brand Mention Monitor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/k05bfa7NlOQLER8tY/): Searches TikTok for posts matching any keyword, brand name, or handle, flagging caption text matches and listing formally tagged mentions, engagement, and author details.
- [Tokopedia Search, Category & Price Drop Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/bOmVHQGZm6vdyV601/): Search Tokopedia by keyword, browse a category or top-sellers list, or look up specific product URLs, and get price, discount, rating, and seller details for each Indonesian marketplace listing.
- [Totaljobs UK Vacancy Finder by Keyword, Area & Pay](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/oa2Q6nW8vIp072JMx/): Finds live UK vacancies on Totaljobs by job title and city, by browsing a whole region, or by salary band, returning title, company, salary, location and application link.
- [Transfermarkt Player Market Value & Transfer Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/uDm2vSfKpT4iHtZSa/): Look up football players, clubs, and competitions on Transfermarkt. Get player market value history, transfer records, injury logs, club squads, and competition club lists by name or ID.
- [Ubersuggest Keyword Suggestions by Country & Language](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/0yCtho2br9zhoWb26/): Returns related keyword suggestions for a seed keyword or domain, scoped to a chosen country and language, from a public no-login suggestion feed.
- [Unsplash Photo Search by Topic, Collection & Creator](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/hyzBjwc4TeOTrPbn3/): Searches Unsplash by keyword or browses a curated topic, numbered collection, or photographer's portfolio, returning photo dimensions, orientation, license, and photographer credit.
- [US Walkability, Transit & Bike Score Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/e6LDeTzJu7sTkzu3x/): Looks up Walk Score, Transit Score, and Bike Score for any US city or street address, returning each 0-100 score with its rating label and nearby amenity categories.
- [VivaReal Colombia Real Estate Listings by City & Price](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/Mz9MrwVRNHun4oNiK/): Search VivaReal Colombia for properties for sale or rent by city, neighborhood, property type, price range, bedrooms, and area, and get back price, size, address, photo, and listing URL for each match.
- [Vivino Wine Ratings & Tasting Profile Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/g1kkodoLYUEZBw5Kk/): Search Vivino wines by name, browse by type and country, look up specific vintages by ID, or pull a winery's full catalogue. Get ratings, prices, grapes, tasting notes, and food pairings for each wine.
- [Wallapop Listings by Keyword, Item & Seller](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/mGhZBe0V7WirMKlSs/): Searches Wallapop by keyword and location, fetches a specific item by URL, or pulls a seller's full listing set, returning price, location, images, and seller details.
- [We Work Remotely Job Listings & Salary Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/u2oA6UQc4XzfqURHB/): Reads We Work Remotely category pages or keyword search results and follows each listing for salary range, employment type, skills, applicant region requirements, and company details.
- [Willhaben Marketplace, Cars & Real Estate Listings Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/sSrZYqOzOQO2bTYr4/): Search Willhaben.at classifieds, used cars, and real estate (rent or buy apartments, houses, land) by keyword, price range, and sort order. Get listing prices, locations, images, and category-specific details such as car mileage or living area.
- [X Article Announcement Post Metadata Collector](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/o7cusCXLyJuONdRYF/): Turn an X (Twitter) Article's announcement post or article link into structured metadata: title, preview text, cover image, publish date, and the announcement post with its author.
- [X Broadcast Viewer History & Replay Link Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/z0s6TC1YoFaRHOdjO/): Get a public X broadcast's title, state, start/end times, viewer counts over time, thumbnail, broadcaster profile, and an optional replay stream link, resolved from a broadcast link or ID.
- [Y Combinator Startup Directory with Founders & Jobs](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/fbBWIR9F8RcmhmS4l/): Search Y Combinator's company directory by batch, industry, status, or keyword, and get each company's profile, founders, and open job postings. No login required.
- [YouTube Community Tab Post & Poll Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/TgWj38cfCgu54papJ/): Read a YouTube channel's Community tab and get structured records for every text post, image, poll, and shared video, with vote counts and optional comment threads.
- [YouTube Search Suggestions Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/dIA3WsgJjUVXiVu24/): Get public YouTube autocomplete suggestions for keyword research, content discovery, and SEO planning.
- [Zillow Distressed Property Finder by City or ZIP](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/TFgUch48s7mbPQ6Kw/): Find foreclosure, pre-foreclosure, bank-owned, and auction properties on Zillow by city, neighborhood, or ZIP, with price, Zestimate, tax value, and property specs for each listing.
- [ZipRecruiter Jobs with Full Description Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/6HsKvw9VT0JJhsrtu/): Search ZipRecruiter by keyword and location, or a direct search URL, and get each job's full description text alongside company, location, salary, and remote/hybrid details.
